text_block_list.text:
Worried about Nice Nature not showing up 
for training, I went looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Even if it's predictable, you really 
do look forward to that classic 
catchphrase, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Electronics Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's our Nat-chan for ya! That's the 
best part of "Carrot Koumon," after all~.

"...Nice Nature was intently watching the 
TV in front of the electronics store."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Her usual attendants have joined in! 
Now then, will it make an appearance 
here?! That heirloom family crest—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer! What are you doing in a 
place like this...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sounds like a line from a period 
drama. Wait, what did you mean... by 
tracksuits...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaah!! That's right, I had training 
today!
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to be careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ha, hahah! I'll turn over a new leaf... 
and do my best...!

And with that, case closed! ...Or so it 
seemed.
